title: 404 & Redirect Audit
description: Find broken URLs, fix 404 errors, and set up redirects after content changes or migrations.

steps.title: Pull 404 Errors from Search Console
steps.instructions: Review Coverage and Pages reports in Google Search Console for soft 404s and not-found URLs worth fixing.

steps.title: Run a Broken Link Scan
steps.instructions: Scan the homepage, top landing pages, and sitemap URLs with a broken-link checker or SEO plugin audit.

steps.title: Fix Internal Broken Links
steps.instructions: Update menus, content links, and widgets pointing to deleted pages. Link to the correct replacement URL.

steps.title: Add 301 Redirects for Moved URLs
steps.instructions: Redirect old URLs to their new locations using your SEO or redirect plugin. Avoid redirect chains longer than one hop.

steps.title: Improve the 404 Page
steps.instructions: Customize the 404 template with search, popular links, and a clear path back to the homepage.

steps.title: Normalize Trailing Slashes & WWW
steps.instructions: Pick www or non-www and trailing-slash policy. Redirect inconsistent variants to the canonical URL.

steps.title: Re-test Top URLs
steps.instructions: Verify former 404 URLs now return 200 or 301. Re-submit important URLs in Search Console if needed.
